description: Multi-project Arch Linux / BSPWM desktop ecosystem

ani-cast.description: Anime streaming, Chromecast casting, MPV resume hooks, and PySide6 player GUI.

ant-gm320.description: Native Linux GUI for Ant Esports GM320 mouse (RGB lighting, DPI, button remapping).

keyholder-hud.description: Zero-latency X11 floating HUD overlay for keylock status, modes, and keystroke indicators.

polybar-music.description: High-efficiency C streaming D-Bus media widget for Polybar with dynamic track animation.

qt-music.description: Low-resource music player, synchronized lyrics renderer, and background audio daemon.

sys-alarm.description: High-volume alarm clock with systemd RTC suspend-wake synchronization and PipeWire speaker routing.

sys-control.description: Sub-2ms hotkey, brightness, screenshot, and window management daemon replacing shell scripts.

sys-launcher.description: Ultra-fast dual-mode native application launcher and desktop visibility manager.

sys-notif.description: Modern lightweight desktop notification daemon and OSD server replacing Dunst/Mako.

sys-notif-center.description: Notification center GUI and persistent message history viewer with grouping and filters.

Toshiba Porteger r700.description: Hardware architecture specifications and device tuning for host laptop (Toshiba Portégé R700).

xmodmap-watcher.description: Auto-reloads ~/.Xmodmap on X11 MappingNotify and USB keyboard hotplug events.
